\section{Declarations}

\begin{lemma}[Integral bounded by the $L^p$ norm]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.norm_integral_le_toReal_eLpNorm}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.norm_integral_le_toReal_eLpNorm}
\leanok
\difficulty{3}
Let $(\alpha,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $p\in[1,\infty]$, and let
$f\colon\alpha\to\mathbb R$ belong to $L^p(\mu)$. Then $\left|\int
f\,d\mu\right|\leq\|f\|_{L^p(\mu)}$.
\end{lemma}
